name: White Bandage
description: A fresh white bandage worn on Lena's left thumb, which becomes grey with grime over the course of the night. It is visible to Ruth at the boathouse in the pre-dawn hours.
narrative_significance: The bandage serves as a visual marker of Lena's physical state and the passage of time through the night. Its deterioration from white to grey with grime reflects the stress and urgency of her mission. It also functions as a recognizable detail that Ruth notices, establishing continuity between scenes and suggesting Lena's involvement in a physically demanding or dangerous situation.
